**UE Context Release Request gets a Command**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NGAP / UE Context Management Procedures / UE Context Release Request (NG-RAN node initiated) |
| Tags | none |
| Verdict class | DEVIATION |

## Clauses

- TS 38.413 8.3.2.2 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-18: V18.1.0 splits the should by cause: with "User inactivity" the release should be initiated when there is no downlink signalling; Rel-15 to Rel-17 have one unconditional sentence; Rel-19: the cited text is unchanged; V19.1.0 adds a GW Context Release Indication sentence)

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NGAP-UE-CTX-RELEASE-ON-REQUEST.md).
